borrowing_policy: PROPOSED v1, NOT YET HUMAN-FROZEN: Arabic digits, mathematical symbols, variable names, INR/rupee notation, %, L, mL, m, cm, km, kg, g, h, minute, metre, litre, kilometre, centimetre, millilitre, kilogram, gram, hour and their ordinary Roman spellings may be shared. Established Hindi loan nouns bus, cycle, jag, tikat and pensil are proposed common borrowings. Names are shared entities. R must otherwise use Hindi phrasing in Roman script; substantive English clauses/relations are disallowed. C requires a productive English predicate, clause or mathematical relation alongside Hindi; object nouns alone do not qualify. Reviewers must flag disputed borrowings before the policy is frozen.
